sentences.text: Vinod Pandit vs Sangeeta Sharma on 16 October, 2023

T.P.(
 ITEM NO.1601 COURT NO.14 SE  S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A  RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS  TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NOS. 778-779/2023  VINOD PANDIT PETIT  VERSUS  SANGEETA SHARMA RESPO  (FOR ADMISSION and IA No.212032/2023-STAY APPLICATION  No.212033/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. )
 Date : 16-10-2023
These petitions were called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH

For Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Akash Gupta, Adv.
 Mr. Abhay Kumar Tayal, AOR
UPON hearing the counsel, the Court made the following  O R D E R

After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner-husband submits that he has filed the present transfer petitions seeking transfer of two cases filed by the respondent-wife against him, i.e.
one under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and the other under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
But if he may be permitted to appear virtually, he may not have any objection.

Having regard to the above stand, the transfer petitions are disposed of with a direction to the concerned Court to allow the petitioner-husband to take part in the proceedings through virtual mode and, as and when the personal presence would be, in general, required, the Court would have the discretion to call for such personal appearance of the petitioner-husband.
